anywhere can contain links as they are processed after wiki conversion

and they can be absolute page3 like so.

To disable quick links in text just use another chunk with form=markdown and include it

We can also link to dir with a trailing slash like Page4 which will of course use the index.html inside the dir.

Links to images such as test.png can be upgraded to inline with some simple javascript. See ^.html for example.

Links are forced to lowercase only, but capitals can be used for display text.

All we are doing here is adding a simple way to put obvious quick links between pages into markdown text.
